entries.name: Cecil Rhodes
entries.content: Cecil Rhodes was a motherly figure to Emily Albarn when Emily was an orphan, raising her and teaching her about necromancy. During Emily's teenage years, Cecil committed a grave sin by attempting to impose her philosophy on the world, twisting it for the better while defying the laws of nature. As a result, she was killed by her own master, Viktor Schliemann.

entries.name: Emily Albarn
entries.content: Emily Albarn is the apprentice of Viktor, who was raised and taught by Cecil. After having to kill Cecil with his own hands, Viktor swore that he would never allow anything like that to happen again and took Emily Albarn as his apprentice to ensure she would walk the path of a true necromancer. While Viktor constantly nags her about her shy and childlike simplicity, he cares for her deeply.
